profile.headline: Owner at Branch Creative
profile.summary:
I’m a Frontend WordPress Developer with 9 years of experience building fast, scalable, and fully custom websites for agencies, enterprise teams, and universities. I specialize in creating complete WordPress themes from scratch — including custom Gutenberg blocks, dynamic render callbacks, ACF field architectures, custom post types, and advanced integrations.

For the last 9 years, I’ve worked fully remote, partnering closely with designers, strategists, and marketing teams to deliver polished, accessible, user-friendly experiences. I’m comfortable in fast-paced agency environments and equally confident working autonomously.

Core strengths include:

Custom Gutenberg block development (ACF + block.json + PHP render callbacks)

Tailwind, SCSS, and modern frontend workflows

Custom theme development from scratch

CPTs, taxonomies, complex ACF field groups

JavaScript interactivity (GSAP, Swiper, custom modules)

Template architecture and component systems

Debugging complex PHP, JS, and editor preview issues

Integrating marketing systems (Marketo, ActiveCampaign, Iubenda)

Pixel-perfect implementation from Figma

Remote communication & agency-style collaboration

I’m currently exploring remote or hybrid frontend developer roles where I can build custom solutions and contribute to a high-quality engineering culture. Open to opportunities with agencies, universities, SaaS companies, or any team that values well-built WordPress experiences.

If you’re looking for a developer who can own a project from block architecture through final deployment, I’d love to connect.
